reason: The README describes a DSH plugin suite primarily focused on coordinating agent execution through failure handling, planning reminders, memory management, skill loading, and shared workflow discipline, with secondary file and environment tools.

summaries.zh: 通过失败处理、任务规划、记忆去重和技能加载等机制，帮助 DeepSeek Harness 智能体更有纪律地执行任务，并提供文件查找与环境检查工具。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin suite that improves agent execution through failure handling, task planning, memory deduplication, skill loading, and file and environment tools.

capabilities: Injects execution-discipline rules and reminders into DSH turns
Intercepts repeated failures and can deny or redirect repeated attempts
Maintains shared failure logs, turn statistics, and deduplicated cross-session memory
Provides file lookup and environment health-check tools
Installs and removes scoped plugin, skill, configuration, and script files under the user DSH directory
